title: Kaolinite sorption isotherms of benzalkonium and dialkyldimethylammonium compounds under dilute conditions investigated by direct and passive sampling methods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00122F, Paper
Satoshi Endo, Anh T. Ngoc Do, Sakura Yoshii, Masami K. Koshikawa, Sadao Matsuzawa
Kaolinite sorption isotherms of cationic surfactants were nonlinear even at low surfactant concentrations (<0.2% of CEC), indicating high sorption site heterogeneity.
